title: Ecobee HVAC Runtime Status Mix
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(filter_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the ecobee HVAC runtime feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `filter_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your ecobee HVAC runtime feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
